---
name: problem-to-solution
description: Convert ambiguity into measured experiments, specs, and verified delivery.
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, the brief, specs, and relevant code. Identify baseline, target, stakeholder, and assumptions. Define contracts and executable acceptance IDs. Choose the smallest reversible experiment, collect actual feedback, and revise the spec. Implement in vertical slices; run all gates. Follow `docs/prototype-to-production.md` before promotion. Do not invent approval or evidence.
